_approach: Neuro tension breakdown: no kick at all - a mechanical rim/hat tick pattern decays in velocity bar to bar as if trailing off into a long reverb tail, the Loopmasters neurofunk-breakdown technique of extending a percussion loop under reverb before the drum fill returns.
